# Public PowerPoint fixture

`python-pptx-test.pptx` is the upstream `tests/test_files/test.pptx` fixture from
[`scanny/python-pptx`](https://github.com/scanny/python-pptx), pinned to commit
[`278b47b1dedd5b46ee84c286e77cdfb0bf4594be`](https://github.com/scanny/python-pptx/commit/278b47b1dedd5b46ee84c286e77cdfb0bf4594be).

- Source: `https://github.com/scanny/python-pptx/raw/278b47b1dedd5b46ee84c286e77cdfb0bf4594be/tests/test_files/test.pptx`
- License: [MIT](https://github.com/scanny/python-pptx/blob/278b47b1dedd5b46ee84c286e77cdfb0bf4594be/LICENSE)
- Retrieved: 2026-08-16
- SHA-256: `8765677cdf43181ef41657cedf28485b5f2cbf166667218c217af07f8336c96f`
- Purpose: exercise Template Profile inspection and heuristic mapping against a public,
  externally authored Office Open XML presentation with named layouts and real placeholder
  metadata.

The fixture is intentionally kept byte-for-byte identical to the upstream file.
